AGENDA
  GLENDALE ARTS AND CULTURE COMMISSION
  MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING – 633 E. Broadway, Room 105 (MSB 105)
  Glendale, CA 91206
 Welcome to Glendale City Hall. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and
 rebroadcast throughout the week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the
 proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office. Meetings are also archived on the
 City Website for viewing anytime at http://www.glendaleca.gov/government/agendas-minutes. If you
 have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the City
 Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE COUNCIL CHAMBER.
 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
 language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
 are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
 requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related
 to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and
 are public records, will be available for review in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM
 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
 Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
 wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
 Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify
 the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not
 required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.
  JULY 16, 2020 AT 2:00 PM

Due to the evolving situation with the COVID-19 novel coronavirus and health recommendations from
the LA County Health Department, the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission meeting will be
available to the public electronically.

Due to social distancing requirements, the public will not be able to attend the meeting. The public is
encouraged to watch and participate from the safety of their homes to practice social distancing.

The meeting can be viewed:
On local cable: Charter Cable Channel 6 and AT&T U-verse Channel 99.
Streaming Online: https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/public-meeting-portal

For public comments and questions during the meeting call (818) 937-8100.
 City staff will be submitting these questions and comments in real time to the appropriate person
during the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission meeting.

  1. REGULAR BUSINESS AGENDA – 2:00 PM
  Roll Call
  a. Report of Recorder, re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the July 16, 2020
  Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission was Posted on July
  13, 2020 on the Bulletin Board Outside City Hall.
  2. CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the
  Commission or the audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such
  request before motion is proposed.
  a. Minutes of the June 18, 2020 Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission.
  b. Minutes of the June 30, 2020 Special Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission’s
  Artist Review and Selection Committee for the Art Happens Anywhere (AHA)
  Program – Second Round of Applications.
  3. INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Jennifer Fukutomi-Jones, Arts &
  Culture Administrator
  4. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes.
  Members of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the
  Speaker, but there will be no Debate or Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff
  Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.
  5. ACTION ITEMS
  a. Report on the Art Happens Anywhere (AHA) Program – Additional Funding
  Allocation
  Motion to approve additional funding for the Art Happens Anywhere (AHA) Program in an
  amount not to exceed $30,000 from the 2019-2020 Work Plan.
  b. Report on the Art Happens Anywhere (AHA) – Second Round of Applications
  Motion to approve funding artist proposals from the second round of applications for the
  Art Happens Anywhere (AHA) Program in project budgets ranging from $3,000 - $15,000
  from the 2019-2020 Work Plan.
  c. Report on the Black History Month – Call for Artists
  Motion directing Staff to draft a Call for Artists – Black History Month.
  d. Report on a Year-Long Focus on Cultural Diversity and Racism – Cultural
  Programming
  Motion directing Staff to plan and execute a year-long cultural engagement program
  recruiting authors, curators, historians, panelists, and speakers to present both online and
  in-person exhibits and presentations not to exceed $25,000 from the 2019/2020 Work
  Plan.
  6. DISCUSSION ITEMS
   a. Report on Measure S – Arts and Culture Funding
  Motion to note and file.
  b. Report on the Glendale Public Art Map
  Motion to note and file.
  c. 2019-2020 Work Plan Progress Updates
  1. CITY-WIDE ARTS
  i. Art Happens Anywhere – First Round Funded Proposals
  ii. Beyond the Box –Utility Box Mural Program Application
  2. NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS
  3. PERFORMING ARTS
  4. ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS

7. GLENDALE ARTS AND CULTURE/STAFF COMMENTS
8. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS
9. ADJOURNMENT
  The next Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission is Thursday, August
  20, 2020, at 2:00 PM, in City Council Chambers, 2nd Floor, 613 E. Broadway Glendale, CA
  91206.
